catalog_source: public/data/catalog.sqlite table songs (read-only metadata: id, name, name_ja, name_en, category, source_url)
note_on_345: The current catalog denominator is 590 songs, not 345. 563 have vocadb.net source URLs; 27 are wiki/manual entries without VocaDB IDs.
limitation: Documented VocaDB GET /api/songs has no ids[] batch parameter. Existing cache already requested fields=Names,PVs,WebLinks for a subset. This research did not make hundreds of per-song live calls for the remaining 416 VocaDB catalog IDs. Absence from this file is not evidence that a song lacks a Korean alias.
